fi-hypoplectrus-indigo.title: Indigo Hamlet
fi-hypoplectrus-indigo.summary: A small Caribbean sea bass (hamlet). Hamlets are hermaphrodites, carrying both male and female organs, and have been bred in captivity.
rows: About 6 in (Saltwaterfish.com adult size); wild record 14.3 cm (5.6 in) TL (FishBase)
Carnivore: marine pellets, frozen or live brine and mysis shrimp and small crustaceans, two or three times a day
Western Central Atlantic: Haiti, Bahamas, Jamaica, Cayman Islands, Florida (USA) and continental western Caribbean
notes: Give open swimming space plus caves and crevices to hide in.
warn: Eats small crustaceans and fish, so not safe with small shrimp.
